title: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 8 (Reengineering of Affairs, etc.)
The Minister of the Interior and Safety may redesign and standardize administrative classification numbers, forms, and business procedures so that they are suitable for electronic processing for the joint use of administrative information necessary for personnel management of public officials, and may, after consultation with the heads of local governments and the chairpersons of local councils, reflect the results in the electronic personnel management system. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
